entity.ambient_sound_activity.title: Play an ambient sound for an entity
entity.ambient_sound_activity.descriptio: The `AmbientSoundActivityEntry` is an activity that plays an ambient sound for an entity. This can be used to make an entity sound like it is doing something. Like playing a sound when it is building a structure. Or having it mumble to itself.
entity.audience_activity.title: Select activity based on the audience a player is in
entity.audience_activity.description: The `Audience Activity` is an activity that filters an audience based on the audience a player is in. The activity will go through the audiences in order and the first one where the player is part of the audience will have the activity selected. This can only be used on an individual entity instance. This could be used to make a bodyguard distracted by something and walk away just for the player.
entity.audience_activity.fields.defaultA: The activity that will be used when the player is not in any audience.
entity.bobbing_activity.title: Makes the entity bob up and down, like a floating item.
entity.bobbing_activity.description: Makes an entity gently bob up and down, creating a floating effect. This activity is perfect for: - Making entities other than dropped items appear more dynamic like the dropped items. - Giving decorative entities a subtle animation to make them feel more alive. - Creating a visual cue for interactive objects, like a quest item that pulses slightly. You can control how fast the entity bobs and the amplitude of its motion. It can also be combined with other movement activities. For example, you could have an entity patrol along a path while also bobbing.
entity.bobbing_activity.fields.childActi: The activity that supplies the base position. If not set, the entity will bob in place around its initial position.
entity.eye_height_debug_activity.title: A debug activity that visualizes the entity's eye height
entity.eye_height_debug_activity.descrip: The `EyeHeightDebugActivityEntry` is an activity that visualizes the entity's eye height it is primarily used for debugging purposes. In normal situations, this activity should not be used.
entity.game_time_activity.title: A game time activity
entity.game_time_activity.description: The `GameTimeActivityEntry` is an activity that activates child activities at specific times in the game. The total time of a Minecraft day is `24000` ticks. Some examples of times are: ------------------------------ | Time of day | Ticks        | |-------------|--------------| | Dawn        | 0            | | Noon        | 6000         | | Dusk        | 12000        | | Midnight    | 18000        | ------------------------------ This can be used to create schedules for npc's to follow. For example, going to the market in the morning, going to the tavern at night.
entity.in_dialogue_activity.title: An in dialogue activity
entity.in_dialogue_activity.description: The `InDialogueActivityEntry` is an activity that activates child activities when a player is in a dialogue with the NPC. The activity will only activate when the player is in a dialogue with the NPC. This can be used to stop a npc from moving when a player is in a dialogue with it.
entity.in_dialogue_activity.fields.talki: The activity that will be used when the npc is in a dialogue
entity.in_dialogue_activity.fields.idleA: The activity that will be used when the npc is not in a dialogue
entity.look_at_block_activity.title: A look at block activity
entity.look_at_block_activity.descriptio: The `LookAtBlockActivityEntry` makes the entity look at a specific block. This can be used to make an entity appear to observe blocks around it, such as observing a specific structure.
entity.look_at_block_activity.fields.chi: The activity that supplies the x, y, z of the block to look at.
entity.look_at_pitch_yaw_activity.title: A look at pitch and yaw activity
entity.look_at_pitch_yaw_activity.descri: The `LookAtPitchYawActivityEntry` makes the entity look at a specific pitch and yaw. This can be used to make an entity face a specific direction without focusing on a block.
entity.look_at_pitch_yaw_activity.fields: The activity which may return xyz
entity.look_close_activity.title: A look close activity
entity.look_close_activity.description: The `LookCloseActivityEntry` is an activity that makes the entity look to the player closest to it. The activity is specific to the player, then the entity will look at that player. This could be used to make an entity look at the player closest to it.
entity.offset_activity.title: Applies a constant offset to the entity's position.
entity.offset_activity.description: Applies a constant offset to an entity's position. This activity is useful for: - Adjusting the position of entities relative to their base position You can specify the offset as a Vector with x, y, and z components. It can be combined with other movement activities by setting the childActivity.
entity.offset_activity.fields.childActiv: The activity that supplies the base position. If not set, the entity will be offset from its initial position.
entity.path_activity.title: Moving along a predefined path
entity.path_activity.description: The `Path Activity` is an activity that moves along a predefined path. The entity will move to each location in the set in order. Once the entity reaches the last location, it will do the idle activity. This could be used to have a tour guide that moves along the post-important paths.
entity.path_activity.fields.idleActivity: The activity that will be used when the entity is at the final location.
entity.patrol_activity.title: Moving around a set of locations
entity.patrol_activity.description: The `PatrolActivity` is an activity that makes the entity move around a set of locations. The entity will move to each location in the set in order. Once the entity reaches the last location, it will start back at the first location. This could be used to make guards patrol around a set of locations.
entity.player_close_by_activity.title: A player close by activity
entity.player_close_by_activity.descript: The `PlayerCloseByActivityEntry` is an activity that activates child activities when a viewer is close by. The activity will only activate when the viewer is within the defined range. If the activationRange is set, the activity will only activate when the viewer enters this smaller range after it has been deactivated. When the maximum idle duration is reached, the activity will deactivate. If the maximum idle duration is set to 0, then it won't use the timer. When the player has to follow the NPC and walks away, let the NPC wander around (or stand still) around the point the player walked away. When the player returns, resume its path. If the activationRange is set, it can prevent the entity from repeatedly activating and deactivating when the player is at the edge of the range, or allow the player to get closer to the npc before it starts walking again. When the npc is walking, and a player comes in range Stand still.
entity.player_close_by_activity.fields.a: Optional range in which the player has to enter to activate the activity. Must be smaller than the main range.
entity.player_close_by_activity.fields.c: The activity that will be used when there is a player close by.
entity.player_close_by_activity.fields.i: The activity that will be used when there is no player close by.
entity.player_world_activity.title: Spawns the entity in the world the player is in
entity.player_world_activity.description: The `Player World Activity` makes the entity move to the world the player is in. If the player moves between worlds, the entity will move with the player. This can be used to make one entry appear in multiple worlds. Like a dungeon trader that lives in every dungeon.
entity.random_look_activity.title: A random look activity
entity.random_look_activity.description: The `Random Look Activity` is used to make the entity look in random directions. This could be used to make the entity look distracted.
entity.random_patrol_activity.title: Randomly patrol nodes in the network
entity.random_patrol_activity.descriptio: The `RandomPatrolActivity` is an activity that makes the entity randomly patrol nodes in the network. The entity will randomly select a node within the specified radius and navigate to it. Once the entity reaches the target node, it will select another random node and continue. This could be used to make guards patrol randomly around an area.
entity.spin_activity.title: A spinning activity
entity.spin_activity.description: The `SpinActivity` makes the entity rotate around its axis. This could be used to show off a cosmetic on the player.
entity.spin_activity.fields.duration.hel: The duration of one full rotation
entity.spin_activity.fields.childActivit: The activity that supplies the base position
entity.target_location_activity.title: A location activity
entity.target_location_activity.descript: The `TargetLocationActivityEntry` is an activity that makes the entity navigate to a specific location. The activity will only activate when the entity is outside a certain range. This could be used to make an entity navigate to a specific location.
entity.target_location_activity.fields.i: The activity that will be used when the entity is at the target location.
entity.timed_activity.title: Allows child activities for a limited amount of time
entity.timed_activity.description: The `TimedActivityEntry` is an activity that allows child activities for a limited amount of time. When the duration is up, the activity will deactivate. Then the activity will be on cooldown for a set amount of time before it can be activated again. This could be used to make an entity do something for a limited amount of time.
entity.timed_activity.fields.duration.he: The duration child activities will be active for.
entity.timed_activity.fields.cooldown.he: The cooldown time before the activity can be activated again.
entity.timed_activity.fields.activeActiv: The activity that will be used when the duration is active.
entity.timed_activity.fields.cooldownAct: The activity that will be used when it is on cooldown.
entity.trigger_activity.title: Triggers a sequence when the activity active or inactive
entity.trigger_activity.description: The `Trigger Activity` entry is an activity that triggers a sequence when the activity starts or stops. This could be used to trigger dialogue when the entity arrives at a certain location. Like a tour guide that triggers dialogue when the entity arrives at a point of interest.
The activity to use when this is active.
entity.trigger_activity.fields.onStart.h: The sequence to trigger when the activity starts.
entity.trigger_activity.fields.onStop.he: The sequence to trigger when the activity stops.
entity.animated_entity_path_stream_displ: An entity which moves along the path stream path
This path display lets an entity follow the path stream path.
entity.direct_entity_instance_path_strea: A Path Stream to a Direct Entity Instance

The `Direct Entity Instance Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to a specific entity instance. When the player has this entry, a path stream will be displayed to the specified entity instance. This could be used to show a path to a specific entity instance in the world.
An interaction which forces the player to look at an entity
If left empty, the entity where they interacted with will be used.
entity.entity_cinematic.title: Use an animated entity in a cinematic
entity.entity_cinematic.description: The `Entity Cinematic` entry that plays a recorded animation on an Entity back on the player. This could be used to create a cinematic entities that are animated.
entity.entity_cinematic.fields.definitio: The entity that will be used in the cinematic
entity.entity_interact_event.title: When the player clicks on an entity
entity.entity_interact_event.description: The `EntityInteractEvent` entry is an event triggered when a player interacts with a specific entity. This could be used to start dialogue when a player interacts with an entity.
entity.shared_advanced_entity_instance.t: An advanced instance of an entity
entity.shared_advanced_entity_instance.d: The `Shared Advanced Entity Instance` entry is an entity instance that has the activity shared between all players viewing the instance. Simple npc's where everyone needs to see the same npc.
entity.multiple_shared_advanced_entity_i: Multiple shared instances of an entity

The `Multiple Shared Advanced Entity Instance` entry creates multiple shared entity instances that are synchronized across all players viewing them. Create a group of NPCs that all players see in the same positions, such as a squad of guards or a group of merchants in a marketplace.
Max distance at which entities spawn/render for the player
entity.interact_entity_objective.title: Interact with an entity
entity.interact_entity_objective.descrip: The `InteractEntityObjective` class is an entry that represents an objective to interact with an entity. When such an objective is active, it will show an icon above any NPC.
The entity that the player needs to interact with.
The objective display that will be shown to the player. Use <entity> to replace the entity name.
entity.interact_entity_objectives_path_s: A Path Stream to Interact Entity Objectives

The `Interact Entity Objectives Path Stream` entry is a path stream that shows the path to each interact entity objective. When the player has an interact entity objective, and the quest for the objective is tracked, a path stream will be displayed. The `Ignore Instances` field is a list of entity instances that should be ignored when showing the path. This could be used to show a path to each interacting entity objective in a quest.
entity.entity_instance_position_variable: A variable that returns the position of an entity instance

The `EntityInstancePositionVariable` is a variable that returns the position of an entity instance. This can be used in combination with the [PlayerNearLocationEventEntry] to trigger an event when a player is within a certain range of an entity.
entity.skin_variable.title: A variable that returns a players skin based on the uuid
entity.skin_variable.description: The `SkinVariable` is a variable that returns a players skin based on the uuid. The UUID must be a valid UUID, or a placeholder that returns a valid UUID. This could be used to show NPCs of players on a leaderboard.
entity.hit_box_definition.title: A hit box for an entity to allow quest with a different entity
entity.hit_box_definition.description: The `HitBoxDefinition` class is an entry that represents a hit box for an entity to allow quest with a different entity. This could be when using a display entity since they don't have a hit box to allow quest with.
The `InteractionIndicator` class is an entry that represents an quest indicator. When such an indicator is active, it will show an icon above any NPC.
entity.named_entity_definition.title: An entity with a name above it's head and the indicator
entity.named_entity_definition.descripti: The `NamedEntityDefinition` is an entity that has the other defined entity as the base, shows the name and the indicator above its head. This can be used to allow for all entities to have a name and an indicator.
entity.npc_definition.title: A simplified premade npc
entity.npc_definition.description: The `NpcDefinition` class is an entry that represents a simplified premade npc. It has an Icon above the head when an `NpcInteractObjective` is active for a player. And when the objective is being tracked, the npc will have a different icon. The npc also has its display name above the head. This could be used to create a simple npc has most of the properties already set.
entity.npc_definition.fields.skin.label: Skin
entity.self_npc_definition.title: The definition of the self NPC
entity.self_npc_definition.description: The `Self NPC Definition` entry that defines a player entity with the skin of the viewer. Showing the player themselves during a cinematic.
entity.self_npc_definition.fields.overri: Overrides the display name of the speaker
entity.stacked_entity_definition.title: A stacking of entities
entity.stacked_entity_definition.descrip: The `StackedEntityDefinition` class is an entry that represents a stacking of entities. :::caution All properties will be shared between all entities. Even if it is defined on only one entity. ::: Only the bottom entity will have the location of the `StackedEntity` instance. This could be used to stack entities on top of each other. Like having a hologram above a mob.
The entities that will be stacked on top of each other. First entity will be the bottom entity.
